data.title: Body & Health — Starter · Lesson 3
data.subject: body
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Here we go.

[Hook]
Sunny day… Día soleado
Feeling good… Me siento bien
Sand between our toes… Arena entre los dedos de los pies
Let's enjoy… Vamos a disfrutar

[Verse]
I have white teeth… Tengo los dientes blancos
Smiling wide on the beach today.
My foot itches… Me pica el pie
But the waves wash it all away.
I have long hair… Tengo el pelo largo
Flowing in the ocean breeze.
My shoulder hurts… Me duele el hombro
But the sun's warmth puts me at ease.

[Hook]
Sunny day… Día soleado
Feeling good… Me siento bien
Sand between our toes… Arena entre los dedos de los pies
Let's enjoy… Vamos a disfrutar

[Verse]
I have a wound on my hand… Tengo una herida en la mano
From building sandcastles with you.
I feel weak… Me siento débil
But your laughter makes me feel new.
My nose is congested… Tengo la nariz congestionada
From the salty air and the sun.
My knee hurts when I walk… Me duele la rodilla al caminar
But I won't stop until the day's done.

[Bridge]

vocab.en: I have a wound on my hand

vocab.es: me duele la rodilla al caminar
